description: Defines interfaces and classes related to cryptographic proof sources for QUIC, including certificate chains, signatures, and proof verification mechanisms.

classes.name: CryptoBuffers
classes.description: RAII class managing a vector of CRYPTO_BUFFER pointers.

classes.name: ProofSource
classes.description: Interface for obtaining certificate chains and signatures for QUIC servers.

classes.name: ProofSource::Chain
classes.description: Reference-counted wrapper for a vector of stringified certificates.

classes.name: ProofSource::Details
classes.description: Abstract container for implementation-specific proof details.

classes.name: ProofSource::Callback
classes.description: Interface for receiving asynchronous proof results.

classes.name: ProofSource::SignatureCallback
classes.description: Interface for receiving asynchronous signature computation results.

classes.name: ProofSource::TicketCrypter
classes.description: Interface for managing TLS session ticket encryption and decryption.

classes.name: ProofSourceHandle
classes.description: Per-handshaker interface for obtaining proof data, supporting async operations.

methods.name: CryptoBuffers::~CryptoBuffers
methods.description: Destructor for CryptoBuffers, releases owned buffers.

methods.name: ProofSource::Chain::Chain
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a vector of certificates.

methods.name: ProofSource::Chain::ToCryptoBuffers
methods.description: Converts the certificate chain to CryptoBuffers.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetProof
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a certificate chain and proof signature for a hostname.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetCertChain
methods.description: Returns the certificate chain for a hostname.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the TLS session ticket crypter.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandle::CloseHandle
methods.description: Cancels pending operations and closes the handle.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandle::SelectCertificate
methods.description: Starts async or sync certificate selection.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandle::ComputeSignature
methods.description: Starts async or sync signature computation.

methods.name: ValidateCertAndKey
methods.description: Validates that a certificate chain matches a private key.
